DOEL.description: Domain Element (DOEL). Assigns each node/element key to a domain; TYPE selects whether the key belongs to a main domain or a sub domain, and MAIN_DOMAIN_NAME resolves the owning main domain.

TYPE.description: Domain type of this key. 0 = Main-Domain, 1 = Sub-Domain. On write this value is taken from the existing stored record (nDomainType), so it identifies the domain kind of the element.

KEY_DOMAIN.description: Key of the owning domain. On write this value is taken from the existing stored record; for TYPE=0 it may be re-resolved from MAIN_DOMAIN_NAME to the matching main-domain key.

MAIN_DOMAIN_NAME.description: [TYPE=0] Name of the main domain to associate with this key. Used only when TYPE=0 and non-empty: the handler looks up the main-domain key by this name and stores it as KEY_DOMAIN. Ignored for TYPE=1.
